context: Two managers discuss a product line
purpose: Teach: 毀損/百科/後編/運搬/ネック/選別/結びつける/招か

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 評判毀損の事案、対応スピード、上げよう。
lines.en: We need to speed up how we handle reputation-damage cases.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. No filler. Lean forward slightly — this matters. Direct eye contact. Measured pace, each point landing. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の百科辞典的なFAQ、整備します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll put together a comprehensive FAQ on our products.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Steady, willing tone — no hesitation. Slightly faster than the previous line but not rushed. Shows he's ready to move. Small affirmation on the opening word.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 連載の後編、編集が遅れているね。
lines.en: The second half of the series — the editing's falling behind.
lines.style: Observational, matter-of-fact. Slight tilt toward concern but not alarmed. Pause before the dash, letting the problem land. Quieter on the trailing phrase, like she's noting it more to herself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 運搬コスト、見直し中です。
lines.en: Transport costs are being reviewed right now.
lines.style: Even, steady rhythm. No defensiveness — just reporting progress. Warm undertone that says he's handling it. Not rushed. Slight emphasis on 'right now' to show active work.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 人手不足がネック、業務選別、厳しく。
lines.en: Staff shortage is the real constraint here. We need to be much stricter about which tasks we take on.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Opens with conviction — this is the crux. Slower pace on the second sentence, letting the weight of the decision sit. Authority without coldness. The voice of someone making a hard call.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 業界キーマンと結びつける機会、増やします。
lines.en: I'll create more opportunities to connect with industry leaders.
lines.style: Energetic, solution-focused. Slight forward momentum in the delivery. Shows initiative. Warmer than before — this is something he can do. Not performative, genuinely offering.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 招かれた式典、後輩にも参加させたい。
lines.en: I want to invite some of the junior staff to these ceremonies too.
lines.style: Softer register than the earlier directives. More personal inflection. A gentle shift toward mentorship — this is about people, not just work. Still clear and purposeful, but with warmth underneath.
